tg.conclusion: Reviewed Telegram 0.73.0-0.73.1 with Core 0.342.0/Base 0.45.0: tg mcp builds its tools from the commands (188, limited by the profile's levels; arguments are option names in snake_case); an agent's search messages takes text in query only (no ast); an agent cannot mark read or act as owner; conversations rebuild replaces conversations_refresh; TG_READ_ONLY refuses local writes that delete or overwrite saved data; no write goes out while Telegram holds the account; a send blocked on a lock exits 9; upgrade --offline exits 2; conversations build/embed and search conversations are marked as sending text out; model downloads read from an outside service. Changed native pages: query-language, commands, changelog, cli-contract link; RU/ES updated. The getFile URL correction stays: the released commands page still has the bare URL. All ten tg guideRefs retired: the released pages contain the pinned content. Roadmap unchanged: multi-photo sending, private chat notes and listed MAX-only capabilities remain planned.

max.conclusion: Reviewed MAX 0.61.0-0.62.0 with Core 0.342.0/Base 0.45.0: max mcp builds its tools from the commands (181, limited by the profile's levels); an agent's search messages takes text only (no ast) and cannot mark read, act as owner or send any file; conversations rebuild replaces conversations_refresh; session end refuses (exit 2) while a manual or service serve runs; bot message ids must be mid.…; MAX_READ_ONLY refuses local writes that delete or overwrite saved data; agents can mute and unmute; commands that change MAX are now marked as changing something outside this computer. Changed native pages: archive, sessions, query-language, commands, changelog, and release links in bot/usage/cli-contract; EN/ES (and RU commands) updated. All three max guideRefs retired: the released pages contain the pinned content. Roadmap unchanged: optional local copy, event actions, video circles, cloud password and native installers remain planned.

zm.conclusion: Reviewed Zoom 0.27.0: adopts Core 0.342.0/Base 0.45.0 as one runtime identity; Base standards tables moved to @wirecat/cli-base/standards/tables for SDK consumers; command effects and output unchanged. Only the changelog changed; RU/ES updated. Roadmap unchanged: broader reviewed meeting preparation remains planned.
